## What it is

Goulotte / pont de test pour fils Helutherm : U de 10 × 10 mm internes, 100 mm de long. Chaque aimant 8×3 mm a son propre plot latéral (marge + retours en biais), pas un rail sur toute la longueur. Imprimée ouverte vers le haut ; on la retourne pour coller les faces 0,6 mm sur le châssis métal.

## Contexte projet

- Même atelier que le boîtier : A1 Mini, PETG HF 33102, aimants 8×3 mm, fond de puit 0,6 mm.
- Puits du canal plus larges que ceux du boîtier (8,4 vs 8,15) : le disque doit glisser jusqu'au fond d'un puit profond.
- Cible : goulottes 230 V / Grove de la roadmap `../README.md`.

## Design notes

Printed as a U on the bed (open +Z). Local trapezoid pads fuse into one long wall: a solid margin around each well, then angled returns back to the channel. Each well is a vertical cylinder from the bed up to a 0.6 mm bridged face. Flip onto the chassis: open rim and magnet faces meet the metal.

Default `puit_diametre` 8.4 mm (see `puit_diametre_canal` in measurements). The box keeps 8.15 for its shallow friction wells; do not unify them. Walls 1.6 mm. Two magnets by default.

`min_wall = 0.6` is intentional for the magnet faces.

## Don't

- Do not run a full-length magnet rail. Pads stay local around each well.
- Do not put the magnet wells in the U floor.
- Do not tighten the canal wells back to the box 8.15: deep wells need the extra clearance to seat the disc on the 0.6 mm face.
- Do not thicken the 0.6 mm magnet face for the default min_wall.
- Do not close the ends. Wires enter and leave along X.
- Do not print this the use way up.
- Do not drop `epaisseur_paroi` under about 1.2 mm on a 100 mm run.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Changelog

- Local magnet pads with angled returns; well Ø 8.4 mm for deep insertion.
- First test coupon: 10×10×100 mm U.
